productBugs.symptom: Request-context Analysis stores Unverified markers for risk (and by the same code path region and owning_department), but the Contract record projection filters them out. Overview shows no marker, evidence or Confirm, and the Fields header does not count them for Confirm all. Confirms the author's product bug and extends it: the marker is also invisible to Confirm all.
productBugs.reproduction: Enable Fill Contract Fields after conversion; convert a Request whose description supports Risk to a Type whose record Rows include a Field; after the run, GET /contracts/:n aiUnverified lacks risk while contracts.ai_unverified holds it (C-297, C-298). Re-walk: C-323, C-324, C-325, C-326.

observations: legal_team_member: C-297 Request-context run wrote ["risk","doc_030_service_location_1790333761793"]; the record API's aiUnverified lists ["doc_030_service_location_1790333761793"]; Overview shows risk "high" with 0 Risk evidence controls and 0 Unverified markers; Fields header ["Run analysis"].

administrator: C-298 Request-context run wrote ["risk","doc_030_service_location_1790333761793"]; the record API's aiUnverified lists ["doc_030_service_location_1790333761793"]; Overview shows risk "high" with 0 Risk evidence controls and 0 Unverified markers; Fields header ["Run analysis"].

guideFailures.step: At this build, Risk, Region and Department on Overview show no marker or Confirm when this run filled them. ... Confirm all still counts and clears their markers.
guideFailures.expected: With Risk and one Field both written by Request-context Analysis, Confirm all appears in the Fields header (more than one marked value) and clears both markers.
guideFailures.observed: C-297 (legal_team_member) and C-298 (administrator): the run wrote risk "high" and the location Field. The database holds Unverified markers for both, but the Contract record API returns only the Field marker, so the Fields header shows Run analysis and no Confirm all, and Overview shows no Risk marker, evidence or Confirm. Confirm all does not count the Risk marker; with only one visible marker no Confirm all control is offered, so a reader has no way to clear the Risk marker from the record page.
